title: Fulltext QA Report
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; PaperQA2 wrapper). Output of tools/fulltext_qa.py: page-anchored answers over locally-supplied PDFs/markdown, plus deterministic Crossref retraction flags. HONESTY: when the optional paperqa dependency (or its index) is unavailable, available=false with a reason — the machine never fakes a fulltext answer. Contexts carry doc_ref + page + a SHORT excerpt (anchor, never inlined documents); the index cache is fenced into runs/, never the vault.

available.description: false when the optional fulltext-QA engine could not run (missing dependency, no docs, engine error).

reason.description: Required (non-empty) when available=false: why the engine could not answer.

answer_summary.description: The page-grounded answer synthesis. Empty when available=false.

contexts.description: Page-anchored evidence contexts (the PaperQA2 absorption point: claim-evidence loci with page anchors).

doc_ref.description: Resolvable doc reference (path under runs/ scratch, DOI, or arXiv id) — never vault content.

excerpt.description: Short verbatim anchor (<=500 chars), NOT an inlined document.

retraction_flags.description: Deterministic Crossref retraction/concern check results for the consulted DOIs.
